title: How Well Do You Know Honeybees?

questions.q: How many eyes does a honeybee have?
questions.fact: Five! Two big compound eyes, plus three tiny simple eyes (ocelli) on top of the head that help sense light.

questions.q: Which honeybees in the hive are male?
questions.fact: Drones are the males. Every worker bee is female, and so is the queen.

questions.q: About how many flowers do bees visit to make one pound of honey?
questions.fact: Around 2 million flower visits go into a single pound of honey. That's a lot of flying!

questions.q: How many times can a worker honeybee sting you?
questions.fact: Just once. Her barbed stinger gets stuck in skin and she dies. Bumblebees have smooth stingers and can sting again.
